gsc.account: <account alias shown by list_sites, if multiple accounts exist>
gsc.note: export_dir is optional : if set, the skill reads CSV/XLSX exports from there first and only calls the live API to fill gaps. If empty, everything is pulled live via mcp__google-search-console__query_search_analytics.

live_site_access.note: mode is one of: 'url' (fetch live), 'saved_html' (point at local .html snapshots), or 'none' (skip Phase 5 live-page audit)

backend_source.note: Path to the theme/app source root if Phase 5's backend/architecture audit should run. Leave available:false to skip it entirely rather than guessing from the frontend.

dataforseo.note: Set false to skip all DataForSEO enhancement calls (historical rank corroboration, live SERP check, content duplication scan, Lighthouse) even if the MCP is connected.

custom_inputs.note: Free-form bag for anything client-specific that doesn't fit the standard shape above : e.g. a CallRail/leads export, a competitor SERP tracker file, a migration changelog, a CMS-specific quirk. Add keys as needed; reference them explicitly in the relevant workflow phase rather than assuming the skill will discover them on its own.
